name: violin_high
character: One violin high and left, bowing through the collapse above the brass: a strained line that climbs a semitone at a time and never settles on a comfortable note.
description: The strain: a solo violin line in the top octave, entering at the crush, holding through the dilation and climbing into the horizon.
